take.title_zh: 今日資料擷取異常，無法產出精選內容
take.title_en: Data Retrieval Failure — No Curated Content Today
take.body_zh:
今日排程執行時，所有外部資料來源均無法正常取得：TechCrunch 與 Smashing Magazine RSS 回傳無法解析的二進位資料，The Verge RSS 遭封鎖（403），兩次 WebSearch 均回傳伺服器過載（529）。已達 5 次外部呼叫上限，依規則直接進入輸出階段。

建議確認以下事項：RSS feed URL 是否仍有效、WebSearch 服務負載狀況，以及是否需要更新備用資料來源清單。明日排程將重新嘗試。
take.body_en:
All external data sources failed during today's scheduled run: TechCrunch and Smashing Magazine RSS feeds returned unparseable binary data, The Verge RSS was blocked (403), and both WebSearch calls returned server overload errors (529). The 5-call cap was reached and execution proceeded to output per task rules.

Recommend verifying RSS feed URLs, WebSearch service status, and whether backup sources need to be added to the task config. Tomorrow's run will retry normally.
